market_outlook.short_term: Markets face 1-3 month headwind from oil-driven inflation and bond selloff. Expect S&P 500 range-bound 5,800-6,200 with elevated volatility. Energy and gold outperform; tech consolidates. Fed likely holds or signals hawkish tilt given 5% inflation. Iran conflict is primary swing factor.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook constructive for AI infrastructure, energy, and healthcare. $40T debt trajectory forces fiscal reckoning (tax hikes per economist warnings). AI capex cycle extends but rotation toward 100% EPS growth names. Trade wars and climate risk add structural volatility. Australian earnings beat signals global recovery breadth.
